title: Ravn stage contract v1
description: Seven triage stages, one envelope. What a stage sent to a hook receives from Ravn, the shape of each stage's output, and the answer a hook that may answer sends back (*Answer). No report body, PoC or attachment, ever; no reporter score, rank, priority or reputation; every empty value names why. ADR platform-007.

Maybe.description: Every empty value names why. Present: { value } with a non-null value. Absent: { value: null, reason }. A bare null, {} or [] never validates.

EmptyReason.description: not-run: the producing stage did not run · not-observed: Ravn looked and has no fact, never 0 · unavailable: Ravn could not look (the read failed), never 0 and never not-observed · not-kept: Ravn does not keep this yet · not-declared: nothing declares it · not-configured: the program chose not to send it · not-read: the report body · too-few: similar cases in other programs, below the minimum · not-filed: the reporter filed nothing under this heading at the source · not-proposed: Assess gathered evidence and proposed no verdict

Impl.description: What ran, or will: Ravn's built-in at a pinned version, a hook, or nothing yet.

Envelope.description: The one shape every stage receives, built-in or hook. `packet` is the stage's In; see the per-stage *Envelope definitions for the narrowing.

$schema.description: The published schema this envelope validates against — the document's own $id. Optional because it arrived additively (#640); Ravn always sets it.

asOf.description: Every fact in the packet is resolved as of this instant.

ReporterFact.description: One fact about the reporter, labelled with how it is known — or its name with nothing under it, which is how *not observed* (Ravn looked, no fact) and *unavailable* (Ravn could not look) are said. Never a count of hidden facts.

Answers.description: p(yes) per yes/no question, or a precedent id offered as a hint. About the REPORT — allowed under rail 4.

Filed.description: What the reporter filed beside the report at the source: HackerOne's severity rating and CVSS score, the weakness (CWE) they chose, the scope item. Metadata, never body. not-filed: left blank at the source · not-observed: Ravn stored nothing for this case · not-kept: not stored yet.

bodyAccess.description: Always absent in Phase 1. Not named `body`: assertBodyFree refuses that key even with null under it.

ClassifyAnswer.description: What a hook sends back for Classify: the run it was sent and the stage's output. Recorded as the stage's output; never acted on.

RouteAnswer.description: What a hook sends back for Route: the run it was sent and the stage's output. Recorded as the stage's output; never acted on.

proposed.description: Assess never proposes from metadata: not-proposed when the tool gathered and judged nothing (#652). A hook that reads the report may fill the value.

AssessAnswer.description: What a hook sends back for Assess: the run it was sent and the stage's output. Recorded as the stage's output; never acted on.

ReviewAnswer.description: What a hook sends back for Review: the run it was sent and the stage's output. Recorded as the stage's output; never acted on.

FollowUpAnswer.description: What a hook sends back for FollowUp: the run it was sent and the stage's output. Recorded as the stage's output; never acted on.

precedentId.description: The knowledge entry's id. From a hook, its own reference: opaque, at most 200 characters, recorded and never resolved by Ravn.

reviewer.description: Who reviewed, when a hook at Knowledge can name a person: not-observed when Review named only the source (#656).

KnowledgeAnswer.description: What a hook sends back for Knowledge: the run it was sent and the stage's output. Recorded as the stage's output; never acted on.
